P1-18.P1_flat: - Port options. A setting a bus write stores is a port option when, apart from its read-back, its counterparts show it gives value to or decides some element, and each is an interrupt request output (it picks which events raise it), a flow-control handshake output, or an element decided at a test letting a flow-control handshake input (or its synchronized copy) hold a transfer: it only tunes those ports, which carry the effect. Judge from port names which ports are interrupt requests or flow-control handshakes, never a serial link's clock line, and say so. Judged as usual: those ports, and a setting with an element of none of these kinds (an enable also copied into engine state, clearing a buffer or driving a clock-enable output; a rate setting; a lock; a limit compared with a count). A port option is not a piece of its own, although step 2 names each enable, step 3 splits by use and it gates an output port: keep no concept for it, name it in no concept's information, and cite no line assigning it as a held line. A concept also holding a port it tunes stays, for that port alone.
P1-18.P1_structured:
- Port options.
  Scope: a setting a bus write stores.
  Criteria (all of), apart from its read-back: (1) its counterparts show it gives value to or decides some element; (2) each is any of: an interrupt request output (it picks which events raise it); a flow-control handshake output; an element decided at a test letting a flow-control handshake input (or its synchronized copy) hold a transfer.
  Exceptions: judged as usual: those ports, and a setting with an element of none of these kinds (an enable also copied into engine state, clearing a buffer or driving a clock-enable output; a rate setting; a lock; a limit compared with a count).
  Outcome: it is a port option: it only tunes those ports, which carry the effect. A port option is not a piece of its own, although step 2 names each enable, step 3 splits by use and it gates an output port: keep no concept for it, name it in no concept's information, and cite no line assigning it as a held line. P1-24.P1_flat: - Per-region checks. When the unit makes the same compare or permission check per region or entry and only combines the results (a priority chain, an OR) into one decision, that decision is the piece, held where they combine; the per-region results are its working values (step 3), although step 3 makes a compare of stored state with a request a piece. A per-entry result itself picking where a request goes or which entry an access changes (which port an address selects, which lock is addressed) stays its own piece.
P1-24.P1_structured:
- Per-region checks.
  Scope: the per-region or per-entry results.
  Criteria: the unit (1) makes the same compare or permission check per region or entry; (2) only combines the results (a priority chain, an OR) into one decision.
  Exceptions: a per-entry result itself picking where a request goes or which entry an access changes (which port an address selects, which lock is addressed) stays its own piece.
  Outcome: that decision is the piece, held where they combine; the results are its working values (step 3), although step 3 makes a compare of stored state with a request a piece.

P1-06.P1_flat: - Second copies. An internal register (not a port) that directly copies bits of one other register of its own entity, not as an index, whose other assignments write only constants, and that no condition reads, is a copy kept only while the value moves (2.6). It is not a piece of its own: name its information under the copied bits' piece, and do not cite its lines as held lines.
P1-06.P1_structured:
- Second copies.
  Scope: an internal register (not a port).
  Criteria: (1) that directly copies bits, not as an index; (2) of one other register of its own entity; (3) whose other assignments write only constants; (4) that no condition reads.
  Outcome: it is a copy kept only while the value moves (2.6), not a piece of its own: name its information under the copied bits' piece, and do not cite its lines as held lines.

It never qualifies as primary for any conceptual asset: the register it copies keeps its own label, and the copy can be a secondary (2.7, direction a).
